card.name: Just before G in abbreviations
card.fires_on: The spot right before an expected G-ending acronym, such as the Z in (VZIG), the opening parenthesis before CGD, or the 'and' before SGP. It fires where the next letters would be CG, SG or ZIG.

modes.label: Inside VZIG
modes.description: The Z in the abbreviation for varicella zoster immune globulin, where IG follows.
modes.example: prophylaxis with varicella zoster immune globulin (V<<Z>>IG) may be indicated.

modes.label: Before a spelled-out acronym
modes.description: A bracket or linking word just before an acronym like CGD or SGP.

modes.label: Number before units
modes.description: A stray number in a lab threshold, with no clear link to G acronyms.
modes.example: blood PSA levels < <<2>> ng/mL have been associated

card.writes: It pushes the model toward letter pairs ending in G, such as CG, SG and PG, which begin an acronym.
card.plain: It fires just before an abbreviation ending in G, such as VZIG or CGD, is written out.
